identity.canonicalName: PISA 2022｜数学课堂纪律体验｜中学15岁目标群体｜学生填答（美国英文）
identity.instrumentFamily: PISA 2022 / United States / English / Main Survey / Student Questionnaire

construct.constructDefinition: 数学课堂纪律体验；已直接读取美国英文原题本 ST273 共7项及官方技术报告/附表。此记录仅登记官方指数候选，无可执行评分。与同题块的无计分表单是不同使用形态，不重复施测。

population.populationNotes: PISA 原目标为施测时15岁3个月至16岁2个月、7年级及以上学生；整数年龄/7–12年级仅作目录展示，不能替代原精确年龄窗口，7–12为本项目中学候选范围。美国英文独立抽取版未有新效度研究，不外推为全K12或中国常模。

administration.timeFrame: 原题本当前学校教师/数学课堂经历；未新增回忆窗口
layoutConstraints: 保留完整 ST273 的7项与美国英文原选项顺序；不从摘要或国际占位符重造题。
矩阵抽样来源；完整题块抽出独立施测不自动等同原PISA设计。
不把题块均分、总和或类别代码当官方IRT/WLE指数。

intendedUses.notes: 来源候选与导入准备；待题项使用范围及独立施测适用性审核。

localization.translationSource: NCES PISA 2022 USA English Student Questionnaire, ST273; not the international master or a Chinese translation.
localization.notes: 原英文37项及选项已与OECD官方美国Main PDF核对，公开描述Form包另附来源/改编说明。未建立独立抽取测量等价性，中文目录不是译题版。

source.title: PISA 2022 USA Student Questionnaire ST273; DISCLIM technical index
source.citation: NCES/OECD, PISA 2022 USA English Student Questionnaire, ST273; OECD (2025 revised edition), PISA 2022 Technical Report, Chapter 19, Table 19.A.50, https://doi.org/10.1787/01820d6d-en; official 27 June 2024 codebook.

limitations: Official DISCLIM uses PCM and WLE; no native executable index or arithmetic substitute installed.
Item identities: ST273Q01JA, ST273Q02JA, ST273Q03JA, ST273Q04JA, ST273Q05JA, ST273Q06JA, ST273Q07JA.
Annex table 19.A.50; reverse-coded item identities before official scaling: none indicated. These are provenance facts, not an executable recoding key.
Higher official index values indicate a more favourable disciplinary climate, not more frequent disruptions.
No individual student/teacher labels, norms, diagnostic thresholds, rankings, or cross-tool total.
Student recipient: describe perceived experience and safe micro-actions; teacher recipient: existing-authorized group summaries only. No new disclosure rights.
Raw descriptive FORM answers stay categorical, including negative-worded items; do not reverse them.
reportPlan.disclaimer: 候选元数据不可施测。无计分表单只保留事实/描述，不生成数字或评分报告。学生填写不表示教师可查看该生个体意见。

blockers: English native descriptive Form package is available under OECD written-content terms §1.2 with source/adaptation notice; this catalog candidate remains non-executable WLE metadata. Commercial translation and any actual third-party exceptions are not granted by this package.
Existing native scoring path has no verified official PCM/GPCM/WLE reproduction for these sources; no new scoring engine in this task.
Standalone extraction is a project administration change; matrix sampling/context validity not established.
Production database/admin custom-content deduplication remains unverified.
